create_silu_activation: create a SiLU activation layer that applies x * sigmoid(1.702 * x) to input tensors
create_geglu_activation: create a GEGLU activation layer that splits input in half and applies GELU gating
build_silu_forward_pass: build a forward pass through SiLU activation using a PyTorch tensor as input
build_geglu_with_dim: build a GEGLU activation layer with a custom split dimension for tensor gating
test_silu_vs_geglu: test SiLU and GEGLU activation layers by comparing their output shapes on sample tensors
